The '''Bezim system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Vorc sector/Legends|Vorc sector]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]<ref name="EAOC" /> and contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bezim]]. The system remained loyal to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].
